summary: Tested FoodieVault end-to-end (backend + frontend). 16/16 backend pytest cases PASS including AI extraction via Gemini/Emergent LLM Key, full auth (OTP request/verify/me/update-profile), items CRUD with persistence verification, and mocked Swiggy order. Frontend mobile flow verified at 390x844 viewport: login → OTP (Dev banner shows correct code) → name → home dashboard → hero CTA → share → AI extraction (~12s real Gemini call) → confirm screen with type chips & editable fields → save → item appears in 'Recently added' with stats counter incremented (To Order: 0→1) → detail screen with title/description/tags/favorite toggle/Order-on-Swiggy CTA. All testIDs documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md verified working. Two minor testability issues (tab bar lacks testIDs, no functional impact).

minor.issue: Observed transient LiteLLM error in backend log: 'OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.014, Max budget: 0.001' during one pytest run. extract_with_ai() has a graceful fallback (returns metadata-derived result with suggested_type='place'), so the API still returned 200 - but the AI did not actually run. A subsequent extract call (~2 min later) succeeded. Watch for budget-cap errors on EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; consider raising max budget or adding a clearer error path so the client knows AI fell back to metadata-only.

issues: Console warnings: "shadow*" props deprecated (use boxShadow), pointerEvents prop deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), TouchableWithoutFeedback deprecated (use Pressable). Cosmetic - no functional impact.

react_native_issues.issue: Bottom tab bar items (Home/Places/Recipes/Order/Profile) do NOT have per-tab testIDs. Add tabBarTestID to each <Tabs.Screen options={{...}}/> e.g. tabBarTestID: 'tab-home'. Currently testers must tap by visible text, which conflicts when same word appears elsewhere on screen. Functional behavior unaffected for users.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add tabBarTestID to each Tabs.Screen in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx so test scripts can reliably switch tabs (e.g. tab-home, tab-places, tab-recipes, tab-items, tab-profile).
(Optional) Address deprecation warnings: replace shadow* style props with boxShadow, pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents, TouchableWithoutFeedback with Pressable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 533-line file - acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routers (auth.py, items.py, extract.py, swiggy.py) once it exceeds 700 lines.
JWT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env is a placeholder ('foodievault-super-secret-change-in-prod-2026') - must be rotated to a strong random value before production deploy.

EXTRACTION fallback: when Gemini fails extract_with_ai returns hardcoded suggested_type='place'; consider returning suggested_type='item' or surfacing an error flag to the client so user knows AI failed.

verify-otp uses 'attempts >= 5' check BEFORE expiry check - fine, but counter never resets unless OTP is deleted; if a user enters wrong OTP 5 times then waits for expiry, they get 429 instead of 'expired'. Minor UX nit.
All MongoDB queries correctly project out '_id' (good). Async/await usage is clean throughout.
Frontend confirm-location field is conditionally rendered only for type='place' - tests must account for this when AI classifies as recipe/item.
seed_data_creation: Test users created on each pytest run with TEST_ prefix emails (e.g. TEST_pytest_user@foodievault.app). Items created during tests are deleted in fixture teardown. A small number of test items + 1 'Not a food post' item from frontend run remain in DB for the playwright test user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend testIDs reference (verified working): email-input, send-otp-btn, dev-otp-banner (text contains 'OTP is NNNNNN'), otp-digit-0..5, name-input, save-name-btn, share-hero-cta, share-fab, stat-places, stat-recipes, stat-items, stat-favorites, profile-avatar, empty-home, recent-item-{id}, share-url-input, share-analyze-btn, share-clear-btn, share-close-btn, confirm-close, type-place|recipe|item, confirm-name, confirm-description, confirm-location (place only), confirm-cuisine, confirm-notes, confirm-save-btn, detail-back-btn, detail-favorite-btn, detail-delete-btn, detail-title, detail-open-source, detail-navigate-btn (only if location), detail-order-btn, order-modal, order-modal-close, profile-name, profile-email, sign-out-btn. Tab bar tabs lack testIDs - use page.get_by_text but be careful about duplicates. The Gemini extraction takes 8-15s for first request; allow 35s timeout.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. The two pytest assertion mismatches during initial run were test-side bugs (forgot backend lowercases emails) which I fixed in the test file. Verified all 16 tests pass cleanly afterward.
